description: This file defines a REST controller named HelloController which provides basic endpoints such as welcome, health check, API documentation redirection, and application info for the LMS backend.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for the LMS backend, including welcome message, health check, documentation redirection, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating that the LMS backend API is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request's scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns the application health status as 'OK'.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns information about the Spring Boot application.
